seeds.lactation: Passes into milk; monitor the infant for diarrhoea, thrush or blood in the stool.

Mechanism Of Action: Lincosamide; binds the 50S ribosomal subunit and inhibits protein synthesis. Active against Gram-positive organisms and anaerobes, with good bone and abscess penetration.

Oral: Swallow with a full glass of water, sitting or standing
IV: Dilute and infuse over at least 30 minutes — never IV push

Status: ACMC Essential Medicines list — capsule; injection also available
